answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive experiments on 4 text evaluation tasks primarily with GPT-4: turn-level response, dialogue, text summarization, and story generation.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue responses, summaries, stories (evaluated via quality scores)

answer_2.quote: We introduce four types of baseline methods in the experiments. Among them, both rule-based and embedding-based methods need reference text... Rule-based: BLEU, METEOR. Embedding-based: Vector Extrema, BERTScore. Learning-based: USR, BCR, FED, DynaEval, QAGS.

answer_3.quote: We propose BATCHEVAL, a new LLM-based text evaluation paradigm that evaluates samples batch-wise... We conduct extensive experiments on 4 tasks primarily with GPT-4... LLM-based evaluators, such as G‑Eval and CloserLook, have demonstrated advanced consistency with humans.

answer_4.quote: We choose Pearson and Spearman correlations to measure consistency with humans... Human Inter‑annotator scores are reported as baselines.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators scored generated texts on criteria such as Naturalness, Coherence, Engaging, Overall, Likeable, Understanding, etc.
